test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment In the given sentence.

My uncle and his family __may come__ late last night, but I am not sure.
solution:
The correct substitution is **"might have come ".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• As this sentence shows that the person is not sure of the past happening so will use the correct modal words in this case.
 
• We use the modal verbs "must-have", "can't have" and "**might have"** to make guesses or deductions about an action in the past that we believe has definitely happe
